items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Willie Pajor and Bill Matthews, the way, with me and the big band.

ctx.x: Well, Lee wasn't living up there then. No. He was from here. No, he was here. Because he had been up there and he's there now.

Yeah, but I, no, no, Lee was here. He was playing on that story. Yeah. And anyway, so we got out there, the two trucks, and we tied up on 47 and I think in, where the Riggle Theater at? South Parkway. Well, 47 and South Parkway. South Parkway, man, they never seen something like that in all their life. Boy, we tied up like we did back there in the olden days. And Bill, did we have a ball? And that's when Punch, Punch Miller, well he had been up there pretty good while. Punch Miller, we call him Kid Punch right…
And he jumped up there and, you know, got on the truck and- And played with me.
